items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: He's a very good friend of mine.

ctx.x: He's a very good friend of mine. Now, I don't know if he's still in the business but at that time ------ in '39 ------ he was really a wailing -- you know. And there was Hipe Ginley's on Bourbon Street, too. There were some nice bands in there, bands you never heard. They played together and then accept an engagement and then they'd break up again.
That was the name of an establishment? What's the name of it again?
